extName.message: Linkwash – Tracker Remover for Clean Links
extName.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store (max 75 chars)

extDescription.message: Removes tracking parameters like utm_source, fbclid and gclid from every link. Fast, private, free – no login needed.

commandCopy.message: Copy a clean link of the current page

heroNothingYet.message: No trackers on this page so far

heroUnavailable.message: Linkwash doesn't work on browser pages

siteRulesFor.description: $1 is a site name such as Amazon

siteIsPaused.message: Links on this site aren't cleaned

footerPrivacy.message: Works offline · No account · No data collection

menuOpenCleanLink.message: Open clean link in new tab

menuCopyCleanPage.message: Copy clean link of this page

welcomeText.message: You're protected. From now on Linkwash removes trackers from every link you open. There's nothing to set up and you don't need an account.

overviewSubtitle.message: What Linkwash has done for you since $1.

emptyStats.message: Nothing yet. Open a link with trackers and it will show up here.

resetStatsConfirm.message: Reset all statistics? This can't be undone.

protectionSubtitle.message: Choose which kinds of trackers Linkwash removes. Changes apply immediately.

cat_marketing_desc.message: UTM, Matomo and other campaign parameters that tell a site where you came from.

cat_ads_desc.message: Click identifiers from Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, X and other ad networks.

cat_email_desc.message: Tracking codes from Mailchimp, HubSpot, Marketo and other email tools.

cat_analytics_desc.message: Cross-site analytics IDs from Google Analytics, Webtrekk, Piano and others.

cat_social_desc.message: Share and referral trackers on YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Spotify and more.

cat_shopping_desc.message: Tracking on Amazon, eBay, AliExpress, Temu, Etsy, Booking.com and other shops.

cat_search_desc.message: Session and click trackers on Google and Bing.

cat_affiliate_desc.message: Referral tags that earn creators a commission. Off by default, so the creators you like still get paid.

featUnwrapDesc.message: Opens the real destination of wrapped links from Google, Facebook, YouTube, Reddit and others directly, so the redirect page can't log your click.

featPingsDesc.message: Removes hidden pings that tell a website which link you clicked.

featBadgeDesc.message: Shows how many trackers were removed on the current page.

sitesSubtitle.message: Linkwash doesn't change links on these sites. Add a site here if it stops working correctly.

sitesEmpty.message: No paused sites. Linkwash cleans links everywhere.

sitesInvalid.message: Enter a valid domain, for example example.com.

customSubtitle.message: Add parameters that Linkwash should remove on every website. Separate several names with spaces or commas.

customEmpty.message: You haven't added any parameters yet.

customInvalid.message: Parameter names can't contain spaces or the characters & = # ?

customExists.message: This parameter is already on the list.

toolsSubtitle.message: Paste a link to see which trackers Linkwash removes, then copy the clean version.

toolsInvalid.message: This doesn't look like a web link (http or https).

shortcutDesc.message: Press $1 on any page to copy its clean link.
shortcutDesc.description: $1 is a key combination such as Alt+Shift+C

shortcutNone.message: No shortcut set. You can choose one in Chrome's shortcut settings.

backupDesc.message: Save your settings to a file or load them on another computer.

backupInvalid.message: This file isn't a valid Linkwash backup.

resetSettingsDesc.message: Resets all settings. Paused sites and own parameters are removed.

resetSettingsConfirm.message: Restore all settings to their defaults? Your paused sites and own parameters will be removed.

aboutText.message: Linkwash removes tracking parameters from links before a page even loads. It's free, open source and works entirely on your device.

aboutFactLocal.message: No account, no servers, no data collection – everything stays in your browser.

aboutRules.message: $1 tracking parameters, with extra rules for $2 popular sites

aboutFactFree.message: Free and open source, without ads.
